description: Search for business listings on Bing Maps.

latitude.description: Latitude for 'nearbySearch' mode. E.g. 47.6062 for Seattle.
latitude.title: Latitude

location.description: City, area, or address to search in. E.g. 'London', 'Manhattan, New York', 'Paris, France'.
location.title: Location

longitude.description: Longitude for 'nearbySearch' mode. E.g. -122.3321 for Seattle.
longitude.title: Longitude

maxItems.description: Maximum number of business listings to return. Min 1, max 200.
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: Scraping mode. 'search' finds businesses matching a query. 'nearbySearch' finds businesses near a specific location.
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings. Recommended: use Apify Proxy AUTO group to avoid blocks.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

radius.description: Radius in metres for 'nearbySearch' mode. Min 100m, max 50000m.
radius.title: Search Radius (metres)

searchQuery.description: What to search for. E.g. 'coffee shops', 'pizza restaurant', 'dentist'.
searchQuery.title: Search Query

title: Bing Maps Business Listings Scraper Input
